releases.title: Smarter rights windows
releases.summary: Content now follows your licensing windows automatically, with fewer manual checks.

items.text: Titles are automatically hidden when their licence window ends, and shown again when it reopens.
Episode order is now correct in exported season feeds.

releases.title: Faster publishing and clearer QC
releases.summary: This release speeds up how your team publishes large catalogues and makes quality-check results easier to act on.

items.text: You can now schedule a batch of titles to publish at a set date and time, so premieres go live without anyone on standby.
Large catalogue uploads now finish up to 40% faster.
Quality-check reports now explain each failure in plain words and suggest the fix.
Thumbnails no longer appear blank for some titles after re-publishing.

releases.title: Better regional scheduling
releases.summary: Your regional channels now get more reliable schedules and quicker turnaround on metadata fixes.

items.text: Regional programme schedules now update within 5 minutes of a change, down from 30.
Programme descriptions with special characters now display correctly on connected TVs.
Very large schedule imports (over 2,000 rows) can take a few minutes; splitting the file speeds it up.

releases.title: Highlights in 12 minutes, not 30
releases.summary: Live match clips now reach your on-demand library more than twice as fast, and subtitles stay in sync on full-length replays.

items.text: Clips from live matches are now ready to watch on demand in about 12 minutes, down from 30, so highlights land while fans are still talking about the game.
The quality-check dashboard now flags any video that has been waiting in compliance review for more than two hours.
Subtitles stay in sync on long replays, even past the two-hour mark.
Publishing more than 500 videos at once can time out. Until a fix ships, publish in batches of 200.
